02 · Required stress cases

What every component must survive

Long content

Real case names, customer language, and translated labels.

Empty content

No evidence, no owner, no decision, and partial artifacts.

Dense content

Tables, timelines, metadata, and multiple warnings.

Keyboard only

Visible focus, logical order, and no pointer-only controls.

No color

Shape, label, and stroke redundancies preserve meaning.

Interrupted work

Save failure, local edits, offline state, and conflict resolution.

03 · Agent handoff

Quality brief

Stress-test every component and page under: - grayscale - high contrast - projector washout - reduced motion - 200% text zoom - narrow mobile - long German labels - keyboard-only use - missing icons - empty content - dense content - slow or failed data - no color differentiation RULES - Never rely on color alone. - Preserve focus visibility. - Touch targets must remain usable. - Long labels may wrap but must not truncate essential meaning. - Mobile must reorder information by priority. - Error states must preserve user work. - Reduced motion removes non-essential transitions. - Tables must remain readable or transform into stacked records.
